items.source: Exclusively designed for use with TransactionDefinition.PROPAGATION_REQUIRED or TransactionDefinition.PROPAGATION_REQUIRES_NEW since it only applies to newly started transactions. Consider switching the "validateExistingTransactions" flag to "true" on your transaction manager if you'd like isolation level declarations to get rejected when participating in an existing transaction with a different isolation level.
items.translation: 专为与TransactionDefinition.PROPAGATION_REQUIRED或TransactionDefinition.PROPAGATION_REQUIRES_NEW配合使用而设计，因为它仅适用于新启动的事务。如果您希望在参与具有不同隔离级别的现有事务时拒绝隔离级别声明，请考虑将事务管理器上的"validateExistingTransactions"标志切换为"true"。

items.source: The read-only flag applies to any transaction context, whether backed by an actual resource transaction (TransactionDefinition.PROPAGATION_REQUIRED/ TransactionDefinition.PROPAGATION_REQUIRES_NEW) or operating non-transactionally at the resource level (TransactionDefinition.PROPAGATION_SUPPORTS). In the latter case, the flag will only apply to managed resources within the application, such as a Hibernate Session.
items.translation: 只读标志适用于任何事务上下文，无论是由实际资源事务支持（TransactionDefinition.PROPAGATION_REQUIRED/ TransactionDefinition.PROPAGATION_REQUIRES_NEW）还是在资源级别以非事务方式运行（TransactionDefinition.PROPAGATION_SUPPORTS）。在后一种情况下，该标志仅适用于应用程序内的托管资源，例如 Hibernate Session。

items.source: Exclusively designed for use with TransactionDefinition.PROPAGATION_REQUIRED or TransactionDefinition.PROPAGATION_REQUIRES_NEW since it only applies to newly started transactions.
items.translation: 专为与 TransactionDefinition.PROPAGATION_REQUIRED 或 TransactionDefinition.PROPAGATION_REQUIRES_NEW 配合使用而设计，因为它仅适用于新启动的事务。

items.source: Note that a transaction manager that does not support custom isolation levels will throw an exception when given any other level than TransactionDefinition.ISOLATION_DEFAULT.
items.translation: 请注意，不支持自定义隔离级别的事务管理器在接收到除 `TransactionDefinition.ISOLATION_DEFAULT` 以外的任何级别时都会抛出异常。

items.source: Note that a transaction manager that does not support timeouts will throw an exception when given any other timeout than TransactionDefinition.TIMEOUT_DEFAULT.
items.translation: 请注意，不支持超时的事务管理器在接收到除 `TransactionDefinition.TIMEOUT_DEFAULT` 以外的任何超时设置时都会抛出异常。

items.source: Set the isolation level by the name of the corresponding constant in TransactionDefinition — for example, "ISOLATION_DEFAULT".
items.translation: 通过设置与相应常量名称匹配的隔离级别，例如 `TransactionDefinition` 中的 `"ISOLATION_DEFAULT"`。

items.source: Set the propagation behavior by the name of the corresponding constant in TransactionDefinition — for example, "PROPAGATION_REQUIRED".
items.translation: 通过设置对应常量的名称来配置传播行为，例如 `TransactionDefinition` 中的 `"PROPAGATION_REQUIRED"`。

items.source: Has to be overridden in subclasses for correct equals and hashCode behavior. Alternatively, equals(Object) and hashCode() can be overridden themselves.
items.translation: 必须在子类中重写，以实现正确的 `equals` 和 `hashCode` 行为。或者，也可以直接重写 `equals(Object)` 和 `hashCode()`。

items.source: Must return one of the ISOLATION_XXX constants defined on this interface. Those constants are designed to match the values of the same constants on Connection.
items.translation: 必须返回在此接口上定义的ISOLATION_XXX常量之一。这些常量旨在与Connection上的相同常量的值相匹配。

items.source: The format matches the one used by TransactionAttributeEditor, to be able to feed toString results into bean properties of type TransactionAttribute.
items.translation: 该格式与TransactionAttributeEditor中使用的格式相匹配，以便将toString的结果输入到类型为TransactionAttribute的 bean 属性中。

items.source: The default is TransactionDefinition.ISOLATION_DEFAULT. Note that a transaction manager that does not support custom isolation levels will throw an exception when given any other level than TransactionDefinition.ISOLATION_DEFAULT.
items.translation: 默认值为 `TransactionDefinition.ISOLATION_DEFAULT`。请注意，不支持自定义隔离级别的事务管理器在接收到除 `TransactionDefinition.ISOLATION_DEFAULT` 以外的任何级别时都会抛出异常。

items.source: Must return one of the PROPAGATION_XXX constants defined on this interface.
items.translation: 必须返回在此接口上定义的PROPAGATION_XXX常量之一。

items.source: The default is TransactionDefinition.PROPAGATION_REQUIRED.
items.translation: 默认值为 `TransactionDefinition.PROPAGATION_REQUIRED`。

items.source: Must return a number of seconds, or TransactionDefinition.TIMEOUT_DEFAULT.
items.translation: 必须返回秒数，或TransactionDefinition.TIMEOUT_DEFAULT。

items.source: The default is TransactionDefinition.TIMEOUT_DEFAULT.
items.translation: 默认值为TransactionDefinition.TIMEOUT_DEFAULT。

items.source: This just serves as a hint for the actual transaction subsystem; it will not necessarily cause failure of write access attempts. A transaction manager which cannot interpret the read-only hint will not throw an exception when asked for a read-only transaction.
items.translation: 这仅作为实际事务子系统的提示；它不一定会导致写入访问尝试失败。无法解释只读提示的事务管理器，在请求只读事务时不会抛出异常。
